title: Flasher deck
description: A single Flasher deck file. Full authoring guide: https://github.com/breischl/flasher/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING-DECKS.md

title.description: Human-readable deck name, shown in the home list and as the deck heading.

order.description: Do not set this when contributing a deck. It controls the deck's position in the home list and is assigned by the maintainer at merge time.

cards.description: The cards in the deck, studied as a unit.

front.description: Prompt side. Plain text only (no HTML/Markdown is interpreted).

back.description: Answer side. Plain text only (no HTML/Markdown is interpreted).

frontImage.description: Optional image shown on the prompt side instead of `front`, which then serves only as alt text. A bare filename in the deck's own folder, decks/<deck-id>/ (the build checks it exists, is at most 300 KB, and that the folder holds no unreferenced files).

backImage.description: Optional image shown on the answer side instead of `back`, which then serves only as alt text. Same rules as `frontImage`.
